description: Map reported pathogenic ATP6AP2 variants onto the protein domain structure, coloured by variant class and clinical entity
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import pandas as pd

# ATP6AP2 (UniProt O75787), 350 aa, type I transmembrane protein.
# Domain boundaries from UniProt feature annotation.
L = 350
domains = [
    ("Signal peptide",        1,  16, "#9aa0a6"),
    ("Luminal / extracellular domain", 17, 302, "#4c78a8"),
    ("Transmembrane helix",  303, 323, "#e45756"),
    ("Cytoplasmic tail",     324, 350, "#72b7b2"),
]
# Exon 4 encodes the 32 residues deleted in the delta-e4 isoform
exon4 = (94, 125)

# Reported pathogenic variants, grouped by clinical entity
variants = pd.DataFrame([
    # cdna, protein/effect, residue position for plotting, entity, class
    ("c.168+6T>A", "intron 2 donor, exon 2 skip", 56,  "XLID + epilepsy + parkinsonism", "splicing"),
    ("c.321C>T",   "p.D107D (ESE)",               107, "MRXSH (OMIM 300423)",            "splicing"),
    ("c.345C>T",   "p.S115S",                     115, "XPDS (OMIM 300911)",             "splicing"),
    ("de novo splice", "exon skip, CNS degeneration", 125, "Fulminant neurodegeneration", "splicing"),
    ("c.185G>A",   "p.G62E",                      62,  "ATP6AP2-CDG (OMIM 301045)",      "missense"),
    ("c.212G>A",   "p.R71H",                      71,  "ATP6AP2-CDG (OMIM 301045)",      "missense"),
    ("c.293T>C",   "p.L98S",                      98,  "ATP6AP2-CDG (OMIM 301045)",      "missense"),
], columns=["cdna", "effect", "pos", "entity", "vclass"])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 5.2))

for name, s, e, col in domains:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s, 0), e - s, 1.0, facecolor=col, edgecolor="white", lw=1.2))
    if e - s > 25:
        ax.text((s + e) / 2, 0.5, name, ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=8.5, weight="bold")

# exon 4 region
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((exon4[0], -0.42), exon4[1] - exon4[0], 0.3,
                                facecolor="#f2b701", edgecolor="black", lw=0.8))
ax.text((exon4[0] + exon4[1]) / 2, -0.62, "exon 4 (32 aa lost in $\\Delta$e4 isoform)",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=8.5)

# furin / S1P cleavage producing soluble (P)RR and the M8-9 fragment
ax.annotate("furin cleavage\n(soluble (P)RR | M8-9)", xy=(275, 1.02), xytext=(275, 1.62),
            ha="center", fontsize=8, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=1.1))

colmap = {"splicing": "#d62728", "missense": "#1f77b4"}
offsets = {}
for i, r in variants.iterrows():
    y = 2.35 + (i % 2) * 0.55
    ax.plot([r.pos, r.pos], [1.0, y - 0.12], color=colmap[r.vclass], lw=1.1)
    ax.plot(r.pos, 1.0, "o", color=colmap[r.vclass], ms=6, zorder=5)
    ax.text(r.pos, y, f"{r.cdna}\n{r.effect}\n{r.entity}", ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontsize=7.4, color=colmap[r.vclass])

ax.set_xlim(-12, 372)
ax.set_ylim(-1.1, 4.3)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("ATP6AP2 residue (UniProt O75787, 350 aa)")
ax.set_title("Reported pathogenic ATP6AP2 variants: splicing variants give neurological disease,\n"
             "extracellular-domain missense variants give the glycosylation/liver phenotype")
for sp in ["top", "right", "left"]:
    ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
handles = [mpatches.Patch(color=colmap["splicing"], label="splicing variant (reduces full-length dosage)"),
           mpatches.Patch(color=colmap["missense"], label="missense variant (unstable protein, impaired ATP6AP1 binding)")]
ax.legend(handles=handles, loc="upper left", frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print(variants.to_string(index=False))
